description:
Lowerer (src/compiler2/jobs/body.rs:936-950) owns `source: FunctionSource`
and `surface: FunctionSurface` beside its mutable working state (world,
counters, generated outputs). Walking the input therefore conflicts with
every `&mut self` method, and the walks clone the input to proceed:

- body.rs:1248  `for clause in self.surface.clauses.clone()` -- every
  clause of the function, deep-copied, to call lower_clause(&mut self, ..).
- body.rs:1269  `for capture in self.source.capture_params.clone()`.

Change: the input is not part of the mutable state. Lowerer holds its
source and surface by reference (or `lower` receives them), so a walk over
the input borrows something `&mut self` does not cover.

Before building: list every read of self.source / self.surface inside
Lowerer and QuoteLowerer (lower_clause reads self.surface.is_macro) and
confirm none of them needs the value owned.

Removal ledger: the two clones above, plus any other clone of source or
surface data the cargo check pass shows was there for the same reason.

Signal: gate green, no golden/census/pin movement.
title: Lowerer borrows the function it lowers
